verdict.rationale: Nitrokey, as shown in this evidence, is a hardware security key and HSM product: FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP card, PIV and firmware, managed locally through the nitropy CLI. A USB token has no hosted event service that could emit webhooks, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the pack suggests Nitrokey ships any webhook or event-subscription capability that would make the axis apply.
